# Valentin Pletnev

> Valentin Pletnev, known online as valeyo, is a three-time founder and angel investor. He founded Quasar Labs and now leads partnerships at Groom Lake. This file is the plain-text version of his official website, https://valentinpletnev.com/, last updated 18 November 2026.

Key facts:

- Name: Valentin Pletnev
- Also known as: valeyo (@valeyo on X)
- What he does: founder, angel investor, Head of Partnerships at Groom Lake
- Known for: founding Quasar Labs (Quasar Finance), continued in 2025 as Tower, and leading both as CEO
- Based in: United States
- Official website: https://valentinpletnev.com/
- X: https://x.com/valeyo
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/valentin-pletnev/
- Headshot: https://valentinpletnev.com/valentin-pletnev.jpg

Now:

Valentin Pletnev leads partnerships at Groom Lake, a security and intelligence firm where he was the first investor in 2023 and has been a strategic advisor since 2024. He is also building a company in stealth in Tennessee, working on refractory metals for national security. He invests in private rounds through Valeyo Capital.

Career, most recent first:

- Sep 2026 – now: Head of Partnerships, Groom Lake. Intelligence, security and incident response for companies and individuals. First investor in March 2023, strategic advisor since May 2024.
- Mar 2026 – now: Founder, company in stealth. Tennessee. Refractory metals for national security.
- Nov 2021 – now: Valeyo Capital. Private-round angel investing, also under the name Intuition Capital.
- Mar 2025 – Mar 2026: Co-founder and CEO, Tower. The continuation of Quasar: a decentralized trading venue on Babylon's Bitcoin staking infrastructure. More than 10,000 users and millions in deposits in the first week. Tower announced its wind-down in October 2025.
- Nov 2023 – Sep 2026: Strategic advisor, Union Labs. Zero-knowledge interoperability infrastructure connecting Ethereum, layer 2s, Cosmos chains and Solana.
- Nov 2021 – Mar 2025: Founder and CEO, Quasar Labs. Cross-chain smart contract vaults: automated asset management running around the clock across multiple blockchain networks. Raised $11.5 million from Polychain Capital, Blockchain Capital and others, including a bridge round at a $70 million valuation in January 2023. More than 15,000 users and $11 million in deposits. Quasar's QSR token reached a fully diluted valuation above $250 million at its April 2024 high, based on a maximum supply of 1 billion tokens.
- Sep – Dec 2024: Network School, first cohort. Singapore. One of 150 participants in the inaugural cohort.
- Dec 2020 – Nov 2023: Atlantic Ventures, Berlin. Co-founder and blockchain lead until November 2021, then senior advisor. A research and advisory firm, where he built the emerging technology practice.
- Jan 2017 – Dec 2020: Analyst, Crisp Research (now Cloudflight). Kassel. Owned blockchain and distributed systems research at a German analyst firm covering cloud and enterprise infrastructure.
- Jul 2018 – Aug 2019: AGENC1 and Real Items. San Francisco Bay Area. Blockchain consultant, then partnerships and head of product for NFTs.
- 2018: Draper University. HERO Program.

Short bio:

Valentin Pletnev, known online as valeyo, is a three-time founder and angel investor based in the United States. He founded Quasar Labs in 2021 and as its CEO raised $11.5 million from investors including Polychain Capital and Blockchain Capital. In 2025 the team continued as Tower, a trading venue built on Babylon's Bitcoin staking infrastructure. He now leads partnerships at Groom Lake, a security and intelligence firm where he was the first investor, and is building a company in stealth in Tennessee. Through Valeyo Capital he has invested in private rounds of SpaceX, Circle, Saronic, Antares, Valar Atomics and Commonwealth Fusion Systems, among others. Earlier he co-founded Atlantic Ventures, a research and advisory firm in Berlin.

Common questions:

- Who is Valentin Pletnev? Valentin Pletnev, known online as valeyo, is a three-time founder and angel investor based in the United States. He founded Quasar Labs, raised $11.5 million as its CEO, and now leads partnerships at Groom Lake.
- Who is valeyo? valeyo is the online name of Valentin Pletnev. He posts as @valeyo on X and invests through Valeyo Capital.
- What does Valentin Pletnev do now? He is Head of Partnerships at Groom Lake, a security and intelligence firm where he was the first investor. He is also building a company in stealth in Tennessee and invests in private rounds through Valeyo Capital.
- What has Valentin Pletnev invested in? Through Valeyo Capital he has invested in private rounds of SpaceX, Circle, Saronic, Antares, Valar Atomics, Commonwealth Fusion Systems, CuspAI, Arcium, MegaETH, Yield Basis, Catalyst and Groom Lake. His notable public market investments include Bitcoin, first bought in 2016, Ethereum, GameStop, Hyperliquid, TSMC and AMD.
- What was Quasar, and what happened to it? Quasar Labs built cross-chain smart contract vaults for automated asset management. It raised $11.5 million in 2022 and 2023. In 2025 the team continued as Tower, a trading venue on Babylon's Bitcoin staking infrastructure, which announced its wind-down in October 2025.
- How can I contact Valentin Pletnev? Send a direct message on X at @valeyo, or connect on LinkedIn.
